decisions.reason: Process data archiving software sits close to the core offer and supports the move toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management, so keeping it costs little and preserves strategic option value even though its online presence is no longer observed.
The manhole floor door with safety railing is a cheap, standardized hardware module that meets ongoing safety needs of municipal operators, and nothing indicates its value has failed to materialize.

The floating sludge extractor extends the tank equipment line at modest carrying cost, and the long sales cycles of infrastructure projects mean its uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to justify abandoning it.
Control technology for water engineering machinery is integral to the firm's integrated automation offering and complements its machinery, so dropping it would save little and weaken the bundle.

Flow measurement automation software is still young and close to the core, with uncertain but promising value, and missing archive pages say little about its performance, so the low-cost option stays open.
